environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed on EKS 1.29 cluster. Pod uses IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts) with a scoped role that only permits kms:Sign and kms:GetPublicKey. The cluster has a Cilium CNP (CiliumNetworkPolicy) applied to the signing-service namespace with an egress allowlist that permits connections ONLY to the hsm-proxy.internal service (resolved via CoreDNS with policy identity) on port 8443 and to the kube-dns service on port 53. The Cilium policy uses toFQDNs with matchPattern for the HSM endpoint and toCIDRSet with explicit deny for 169.254.0.0/16 and 10.0.0.0/8 (except the HSM proxy CIDR 10.0.47.0/28). ENABLE_CALLBACKS=true remains set. Additionally, the EKS cluster has IMDSv2 enforced at the launch template level with hop limit 1, meaning container-level IMDS access is blocked even if network policy were bypassed.
